record.relationship: Distinct reported overnight 25–26 December 2017 episode, supported by its own previous-night onset. The earlier REC50-R21-004 November–early-December campaign has no verified actual endpoint; the 7 December reopening was prospective. Neither an earlier completed reopening nor continuity between the episodes is inferred.
record.status_observation: Historical dated evidence only; an unknown endpoint is not evidence of present open or closed status.
record.current_corrections: Customs spokeswoman dates temporary closure to the previous night and normal return to noon26December; a separate correspondent dates the same overnight interruption but cites a trader/goods dispute. Official security and alternative local explanations remain unreconciled. The Libyan-side account preserves returning-national permission. The one-calendar-day date difference is not24elapsedhours, and this episode is not a continuation of the earlierNovember–earlyDecember campaign.
